{"consolidated_memory":"SILENT DROP IN NOTIFICATIONS/PUSH/DISPATCH.PY — FOUR SEPARATE INCIDENTS

File: notifications/push/dispatch.py (Python)
Common symptom across all: silent drop in dispatcher — a send that reports success with no delivery
Covering test: tests/notifications/test_dispatch.py
Standard repro: dispatch to a device token that was rotated

INCIDENT 1 — [2026-01-15]
Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
Fix: added the composite index and backfilled in batches (PR #1497, branch fix/silent-drop-1)
Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 71 days running

INCIDENT 2 — [2026-03-13]
Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call (PR #3441, branch fix/silent-drop-2)
Result: cold start performance improved; dropped 43 percent to 503 ms

INCIDENT 3 — [2026-05-20]
Trigger: users sitting in a negative UTC offset
Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest (PR #8834, branch fix/silent-drop-3)
Result: memory settled at 134 MB instead of climbing past 7 GB

INCIDENT 4 — [2026-06-01]
Trigger: first request after a cold start
Root cause: error swallowed by a bare except handler
Fix: narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate (PR #9715, branch fix/silent-drop-4)
Result: reclaimed 25 GB of blob storage"}
